PG watermark by priority group
panels.description: Ingress priority group peaks, shared and headroom. Headroom above zero means PFC was triggered. Use --collector.pg.include-pgs=0-7 --collector.pg.types=periodic to see where traffic lands.

defaults.noValue: No data: the collector is not enabled (see the Exporter row)

panels.title: Queue watermark against its limit
panels.description: Periodic shared watermark divided by sonic_queue_limit_bytes; above 90% the queue is about to tail-drop (alert SonicQueueNearLimit).

targets.expr: max by (device, queue) (sonic_queue_watermark_bytes_total{instance="$instance",type="periodic",watermark="shared"}) / on (instance, device, queue) sonic_queue_limit_bytes

defaults.noValue: No data: the collector is not enabled (see the Exporter row)

panels.description: time() minus the last redis read of each collector. The exporter caches 15 s; a line growing beyond two minutes means the redis reads hang (alert SonicExporterStale).
